watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, via the watch carry: the descendants with a stop signal blocked (pid and signals), the signal stops after the era (at, signal, sender_pid) and their totals, and any unreadable stops line carried verbatim.
watchme.consumer: cc_0, which reviews the hypothesis at server.py _children_start_clean against the readings and rewrites it as we learn (outline 0.6.1).
watchme.enough: Settled at >= 20 signal stops after PROVED, or 30 days after PROVED (scarcity is the reading). It HOLDS when no live descendant blocks a stop signal and at most 1 of those stops names no sender. Any blocked descendant names a spawn path that bypasses the fix (cc_0 fixes that path or moves the fix into the child); more than 1 nameless stop rewrites the hypothesis toward a narrower window.
watchme.trigger: Every ground beat after this ticket's PROVED crossing (the era floor, read from the ticket log): the probe reads /proc for the live bus's descendants and their SigBlk, and the live bus's stops.jsonl for signal stops after the era. It speaks when any descendant blocks a stop signal, or when enough is reached.

bullets.text: The bus's block outlived its reason in every child; a mask set for one thread's sigwaitinfo is a whole tree's mask unless the spawner undoes it.
